question: A train travels at 72 km/h. What is its speed in meters per second?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To convert speed from km/h to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18.

Speed = 72 × (5/18) m/s

Speed = 4 × 5 = 20 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 20 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the train = 72 km/h

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/91657d7863d2918f30bd2555b9c5d44f141bd212a369fbaa6c70e1c3c24a234a.png] 

**Formula Used:**

1 km = 1000 m

1 hour = 3600 seconds

Speed (m/s) = Speed (km/h) × (1000 ÷ 3600) = Speed (km/h) × (5/18)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Speed in m/s = 72 × (5/18)

⇒ Speed = (72 ÷ 18) × 5

⇒ Speed = 4 × 5

⇒ Speed = 20 m/s

**∴ The correct answer is 20 m/s.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversion Rule

To convert speed from m/s to km/h, multiply the given speed by 18/5.

Basic Speed Formula

Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Ensure that all units are consistent (km and hours or m and seconds) before calculation.

Average Speed

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time. For constant distances at speeds a and b, average speed = 2ab ÷ (a + b).</p
